lines.zh: 我挑着两桶水，从井边走回院子。
lines.en: I carry two buckets of water from the well back to my yard.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，扁担压得肩膀发酸。
lines.en: I do not walk fast; the yoke makes my shoulder ache.

lines.zh: 我穿过广场，去集市上看看菜价。
lines.en: I cross the square to check vegetable prices at the market.

lines.zh: 我沿着田埂走，鞋上沾满了泥。
lines.en: I walk the field paths, and my shoes come up muddy.

lines.zh: 我走去邻居家，借一把锄头。
lines.en: I walk to the neighbor's to borrow a hoe.

lines.zh: 我绕村走一圈，看谁家的门开着。
lines.en: I make a round of the village to see whose doors are open.

lines.zh: 我扛着柴，脚步被压得又短又稳。
lines.en: I carry firewood, and the weight shortens and steadies my steps.

lines.zh: 我从屋子走到地头，一天走四趟。
lines.en: I walk from house to field four times a day.

lines.zh: 我走在路上，和每个扎尔点头。
lines.en: I walk the road and nod to every Zal I pass.

lines.zh: 我去村口等贩子，他总迟到。
lines.en: I wait at the gate for the trader, who is always late.

lines.zh: 我踩着夕阳回家，影子拉得很长。
lines.en: I walk home in the sunset, my shadow stretched long.

lines.zh: 我走夜路带了灯，其实路很熟。
lines.en: I carry a lamp on night roads, though I know them well.

lines.zh: 我绕开晒着的谷子，一粒都不踩。
lines.en: I go around the drying grain and do not tread on a single one.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，这双鞋补过三次。
lines.en: My steps are steady; these shoes have been mended three times.

lines.zh: 我坐在门槛上搓草绳，搓一下午。
lines.en: I sit on the sill twisting rope for the whole afternoon.

lines.zh: 我把米里的石子一颗颗挑出来。
lines.en: I pick the stones out of the rice one by one.

lines.zh: 我在院里劈柴，斧头起落很慢。
lines.en: I split wood in the yard, the axe rising and falling slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，估摸夜里会不会下雨。
lines.en: I look up and judge whether it will rain tonight.

lines.zh: 我把晾着的衣服翻了个面。
lines.en: I turn the hanging laundry over to dry the other side.

lines.zh: 我数了数鸡，少一只，明天再找。
lines.en: I count the chickens; one is missing, and I will look tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我靠着墙歇一会儿，太阳正好。
lines.en: I lean on the wall for a moment, and the sun is just right.

lines.zh: 我把漏水的水桶箍紧，还能用。
lines.en: I tighten the hoop on the leaking bucket; it will serve.

lines.zh: 我在灶前等汤滚，闻着味道发呆。
lines.en: I wait for the soup to boil and stare at the steam.

lines.zh: 我听见钟响，才想起已是下午。
lines.en: I hear the bell and only then remember it is afternoon.

lines.zh: 我蹲下修篱笆，那根桩子又歪了。
lines.en: I crouch to fix the fence; that post has leaned again.

lines.zh: 我把地扫干净，风又吹回叶子。
lines.en: I sweep the ground clean, and the wind returns the leaves.

lines.zh: 我坐着磨刀，磨到刃上照见自己。
lines.en: I sit sharpening the blade until I can see myself in it.

lines.zh: 我看孩子跑来跑去，不用管他们。
lines.en: I watch the children run about and need not mind them.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，手上的活没停。
lines.en: I look up at you without stopping my work.

lines.zh: 你穿的东西，我们村里没人穿。
lines.en: Nobody in this village wears what you are wearing.

lines.zh: 你的鞋很干净，走不了我们的路。
lines.en: Your boots are too clean for our roads.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只是好奇你从哪来。
lines.en: I am not afraid, only curious where you came from.

lines.zh: 我看看你的手，那不像干活的手。
lines.en: I look at your hands; they are not working hands.

lines.zh: 你比我高，可你不知道井在哪。
lines.en: You are taller than I am, yet you do not know the well.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的背包，想里面装得下什么。
lines.en: I eye your pack and wonder what it holds.

lines.zh: 我点了点头，算是打过招呼。
lines.en: I nod, which counts as a greeting here.

lines.zh: 你看我的屋子，我把门掩上一点。
lines.en: You look at my house, so I close the door a little.

lines.zh: 你的眼神很急，我们这儿不兴这样。
lines.en: Your eyes are in a hurry, and that is not our way.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸，回头讲给邻居听。
lines.en: I will remember your face and tell the neighbor later.

lines.zh: 你站得离篱笆太近，我在看你的脚。
lines.en: You stand too near the fence, and I am watching your feet.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，继续掰我的豆角。
lines.en: I smile briefly and go back to snapping beans.

lines.zh: 你走了这么远，脸都晒红了。
lines.en: You walked far, and your face is red from the sun.

lines.zh: 我从井边回头，看了你一眼。
lines.en: I glance back at you from the well.

lines.zh: 我们不认识，可这儿少有客人。
lines.en: We don't know each other, but we rarely get visitors.

lines.zh: 我捂着胳膊，血从指缝里出来。
lines.en: I clutch my arm, and blood seeps between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，靠在墙上喘气。
lines.en: I take half a step back and lean on the wall, gasping.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音在院子里打转。
lines.en: I cry out, and the sound circles the yard.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把锄头抓得更紧。
lines.en: I clench my teeth and grip the hoe harder.

lines.zh: 我手上全是泥，血看不出颜色。
lines.en: My hands are all mud, and the blood shows no color.

lines.zh: 这一下打得不轻，我站不太稳。
lines.en: That was no light blow, and I cannot stand steady.

lines.zh: 我护着头，往门里退。
lines.en: I shield my head and retreat toward the door.

lines.zh: 我知道打不过你，可我不跑。
lines.en: I know I cannot beat you, and I do not run.

lines.zh: 我把伤按住，先去把门闩上。
lines.en: I press the wound and go bar the door first.

lines.zh: 我这身子有十颗心撑着，还站得住。
lines.en: Ten hearts hold this body up, and I am still standing.

lines.zh: 你袋里的盐，比金币让我动心。
lines.en: The salt in your bag tempts me more than gold.

lines.zh: 那种铁钉，我们村半年没见过了。
lines.en: We have not seen nails like those in half a year.

lines.zh: 我不缺吃的，我缺一把好锄头。
lines.en: I lack no food; I lack a good hoe.

lines.zh: 你把布展开，我得摸摸厚薄。
lines.en: Unfold the cloth; I must feel how thick it is.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢讲价，但这次可以。
lines.en: I dislike haggling, but this once I will.

lines.zh: 这袋种子成色不错，怎么换。
lines.en: This seed looks sound; what do you want for it?

lines.zh: 我用两篮豆子换你的刀，行吗。
lines.en: I will trade two baskets of beans for your knife, yes?

lines.zh: 你手里的糖要留给孩子，别给我。
lines.en: Save the sweets for the children, not for me.

lines.zh: 我盯了半天，还是舍不得那几枚。
lines.en: I stared a long while and still begrudge the few coins.

lines.zh: 东西好，价钱也得像样。
lines.en: The goods are good, so the price should be reasonable too.

lines.zh: 你撞了我，我的水洒了半桶。
lines.en: You bump me, and half a bucket of water spills.

lines.zh: 我稳住扁担，才没让桶翻。
lines.en: I steady the yoke before the buckets tip over.

lines.zh: 村道太窄，两个人过要侧身。
lines.en: The lane is narrow; two people must turn sideways.

lines.zh: 我往墙边让，肩膀擦着土墙。
lines.en: I shift to the wall and my shoulder scrapes the mud.

lines.zh: 我手上的面粉蹭到你的袖子。
lines.en: The flour on my hands rubs onto your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你踩了我的脚，我哼了一声。
lines.en: You step on my foot, and I grunt.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，怀里的柴散了两根。
lines.en: We collide, and two sticks fall from my armload.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，先把筐扶正。
lines.en: I step back and straighten the basket first.

lines.zh: 你这身板，撞起来像头牛。
lines.en: With that build, you collide like an ox.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡柴，你从我头上跨过去。
lines.en: I bend for the firewood, and you step over me.

lines.zh: 我媳妇在集市卖布，我在家种地。
lines.en: My wife sells cloth at the market; I work the field.

lines.zh: 我们成亲那天，全村都来喝汤。
lines.en: On our wedding day the whole village came for soup.

lines.zh: 她嫌我回得晚，我说地还没浇完。
lines.en: She says I am late; I say the field is not watered yet.

lines.zh: 我们吵过三次，都是为了钱。
lines.en: We have quarreled three times, always over money.

lines.zh: 晚上她数钱，我修农具，都不说话。
lines.en: At night she counts coins and I mend tools, neither speaking.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子已经会自己去井边。
lines.en: Our child can already go to the well alone.

lines.zh: 我给她留半个饼，她留我一盏灯。
lines.en: I leave her half a cake; she leaves me a lamp.

lines.zh: 日子久了，连吵架的词都一样。
lines.en: After so long, even our quarrels use the same words.

lines.zh: 她手比我巧，我力气比她大。
lines.en: Her hands are cleverer, my arms are stronger.

lines.zh: 我们就这样过，没什么可讲的。
lines.en: This is how we live, and there is little to tell.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的豆子，一颗颗收好。
lines.en: I pick the fallen beans up one by one.

lines.zh: 我把柴捆重新扎紧，掉了就捡。
lines.en: I retie the bundle and pick up whatever slipped.

lines.zh: 路上有枚铜币，我捡起来问是谁的。
lines.en: A copper coin lies on the road; I pick it up and ask around.

lines.zh: 我捡起别人丢的绳头，还能用。
lines.en: I pick up a discarded rope end; it is still useful.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡工具，膝盖咔了一声。
lines.en: I bend for my tools and my knee clicks.

lines.zh: 我不捡不属于我的东西。
lines.en: I do not pick up what is not mine.

lines.zh: 我把碎瓦收进筐里，留着垫路。
lines.en: I gather broken tiles to fill the path later.

lines.zh: 我捡到一个梨，擦擦就吃了。
lines.en: I find a pear, wipe it, and eat it.

lines.zh: 我的锄头掉了，我捡起来看刃。
lines.en: My hoe slips, and I pick it up to check the edge.

lines.zh: 我捡东西慢，腰不太好。
lines.en: I am slow at picking things up; my back is not good.

lines.zh: 有东西进了菜地，我抄起锄头。
lines.en: Something is in the vegetable plot, and I take up my hoe.

lines.zh: 你在篱笆外站太久，我出来看看。
lines.en: You lingered outside the fence, so I came out to look.

lines.zh: 我听见鸡叫得不对，放下碗。
lines.en: The chickens sound wrong, so I set down my bowl.

lines.zh: 你碰了我的水桶，我停下手里的事。
lines.en: You touched my bucket, so I stopped what I was doing.

lines.zh: 村里来了生人，我得去问一声。
lines.en: A stranger is in the village, and I must go ask.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，等你先开口。
lines.en: I stare at you and wait for you to speak first.

lines.zh: 你要往屋里走，我就拦着门。
lines.en: If you move toward the house, I will block the door.

lines.zh: 我把孩子叫进屋，再回头看你。
lines.en: I send the children inside, then look back at you.

lines.zh: 这一片都是熟人，生人一眼显眼。
lines.en: Everyone here is known; a stranger stands out at once.

lines.zh: 我放下扁担，那不是干活的姿势。
lines.en: I set down the yoke; that is not a working stance.

lines.zh: 我握着锄头，站得比你稳。
lines.en: I hold the hoe and stand more steadily than you.

lines.zh: 我不往前，我就守在这条路上。
lines.en: I do not advance; I hold this road.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪，把你路挡了一半。
lines.en: I shift aside and half-block your way.

lines.zh: 锄头在我手里，这条路得先问我。
lines.en: I hold the hoe; you ask me before taking this road.

lines.zh: 你想绕过我，我就退回门口。
lines.en: If you try to go around, I fall back to the doorway.

lines.zh: 我喊了一声，邻居会听见。
lines.en: I call out once, and the neighbors will hear.

lines.zh: 我等你先动，村里人都这样。
lines.en: I wait for you to move first, as villagers do.

lines.zh: 我把锄头换了个方向，刃朝外。
lines.en: I turn the hoe so the blade faces outward.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我才放下一点。
lines.en: You step back, and I lower it a little.

lines.zh: 村里的日子，不想被打断。
lines.en: I'd rather not have village days interrupted.

lines.zh: 我抡起锄头，砸在你脚边的土上。
lines.en: I swing the hoe and strike the dirt at your feet.

lines.zh: 我这一下是干农活练出来的。
lines.en: This swing was trained by farm work.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀撞你，把你顶出门外。
lines.en: I ram you with my shoulder and push you out the door.

lines.zh: 我挥拳打你的脸，手背擦破了。
lines.en: I punch your face and skin my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我打得很笨，但我没有停。
lines.en: I fight clumsily, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 你抓住锄柄，我们各拉一头。
lines.en: You grip the handle, and we pull from either end.

lines.zh: 我踢翻你的包，东西撒了一地。
lines.en: I kick over your pack, and everything spills.

lines.zh: 我一拳打空，自己转了个圈。
lines.en: My punch misses and I spin halfway around.

lines.zh: 我护着身后的人，才敢动手。
lines.en: I strike only because there are people behind me.

lines.zh: 你流血了，我也没多好。
lines.en: You are bleeding, and I am not much better.

lines.zh: 我在这个村子出生长大，没离开过。
lines.en: I was born and raised here and have never left.

lines.zh: 我接手了父亲这块地，地很小。
lines.en: I took over my father's plot; it is small.

lines.zh: 村子在很偏的地方，我就是这里的人。
lines.en: The village is far out, and I am of this place.

lines.zh: 我出生那天，家里连灯都没点。
lines.en: The day I was born, the house had not even a lamp lit.

lines.zh: 我从学徒做起，学会种地和修补。
lines.en: I started as an apprentice and learned farming and mending.

lines.zh: 这间屋子原先空着，我搬了进来。
lines.en: This house stood empty, and I moved in.

lines.zh: 我成年那年，村里只多了两口人。
lines.en: The year I came of age, the village gained only two people.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是学挑水，肩膀压得直不起。
lines.en: My first task was carrying water, which bent my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我生在这儿，也打算死在这儿。
lines.en: I was born here and mean to die here.

lines.zh: 偏僻的村落养出我这样平凡的人。
lines.en: A remote village raised an ordinary man like me.

lines.zh: 灶火扑出来，我袖子烧了一角。
lines.en: The stove fire leaps out and burns a corner of my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我从梯子上滑下来，摔在谷堆上。
lines.en: I slip from the ladder and land on the grain pile.

lines.zh: 井水比我以为的深，我呛了水。
lines.en: The well water is deeper than I thought, and I choke on it.

lines.zh: 一声响，屋顶的瓦掉了一半。
lines.en: With one bang, half the roof tiles come down.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进门板，我缩到墙后。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the door, and I duck behind the wall.

lines.zh: 那股光让我的手指发麻。
lines.en: That light leaves my fingers numb.

lines.zh: 今年收成不好，我一天只吃一顿。
lines.en: The harvest failed this year, so I eat once a day.

lines.zh: 雷打在田边的树上，我蹲下了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree by the field, and I crouch down.

lines.zh: 脚下忽然空了，我什么也抓不住。
lines.en: The ground vanishes, and there is nothing to hold.
